note: Reconstructed and expanded 2026-07-11 from conversation record. Restores the June build (~68 surfaces) plus the tempo/rhythm clock cluster. Some finish/status values are estimates — edit in MAYOR mode. Internal-only material excluded.

districts.name: Glitch
districts.blurb: post-ASCII, materialist-text toolkit — the mark engine

districts.name: Capital
districts.blurb: fundraising as artwork, the open round

districts.name: LGTC
districts.blurb: Language God Tax Compliance — arm's length

surfaces.name: Poemstore
surfaces.blurb: Typewriter street poetry, on the spot, any topic, your price. The origin point of the modern movement — Oakland, 2005. NPR / CBS Sunday Morning / NYT / LA Times.

surfaces.name: Poem Stream
surfaces.blurb: TikTok for watching poems get written. Records every keystroke — the pauses, the backspaces, the choosing — and plays the poem back at its real rhythm.

surfaces.name: SPLIT
surfaces.blurb: Figure-ground reversal type generator. Two tones only, always exact opposites — grid and pinwheel modes, up to 48 blades per glyph. The reversal is conserved: nothing lost or added in the exchange.

surfaces.name: Lexicon Devil
surfaces.blurb: A self-replicating lexicon for ATProto. The first record of the type contains the schema that defines it. To interact is to adopt.

surfaces.name: THE RECEIPT
surfaces.blurb: A jurisdiction-aware counter of statutory privacy exposure accruing in real time as you browse. The bill nobody itemizes, itemized.

surfaces.name: Organology Organ
surfaces.blurb: An instrument about instruments — organology played as an organ.

surfaces.name: N/10^122
surfaces.blurb: How much of everything ever written has ever been read, against the holographic information bound of the universe. A fraction with a very long denominator.

surfaces.name: Text Temperature
surfaces.blurb: Reads the temperature of any passage of text — its entropy, its predictability, its heat.

surfaces.name: Datamosh Workstation
surfaces.blurb: Byte corruption, I-frame destruction, pixel sorting, channel shifting, cross-file mosh. Make the medium's structure visible.

surfaces.name: Sigil Collapse
surfaces.blurb: Glyphs pushed past legibility until they collapse into sigils.

surfaces.name: Asemic Workstation
surfaces.blurb: Tools for writing without semantics — mark-making in the shape of language.

surfaces.name: Figure-Ground Reversal Type
surfaces.blurb: Type generator where letterform and counterform trade places. Pinwheel mode.

surfaces.name: TOP CHICKEN
surfaces.blurb: A deterministic pixel-art chicken for every ATProto DID. Empirically calibrated rarity tiers. Your identity, as poultry.

surfaces.name: Textfield Ecology
surfaces.blurb: A text field left alone long enough develops an ecology.

surfaces.name: Tick Table
surfaces.blurb: A table that ticks. Watch, don't use.

surfaces.name: Aperiodic Pleroma
surfaces.blurb: Aperiodic tiling as an image of fullness-without-repetition.

surfaces.name: Bartlebluesky
surfaces.blurb: A perpetual counter of blocks on the open social web, epoch-anchored and deterministic. It would prefer not to.

surfaces.name: Attention / Tape-Head
surfaces.blurb: The attention mechanism drawn as a tape head — reading everything at once, writing one token at a time.

surfaces.name: SHELLAC
surfaces.blurb: A player for public-domain 78s. Surface noise included; that's the medium.

surfaces.name: Syllababbler v2
surfaces.blurb: A morphophonemic babble engine over a 235-entry morpheme database with a backtracking segmenter. English before it means anything.

surfaces.name: Aureole
surfaces.blurb: An ATProto synonym-field reader. Overlapping letter-blend clusters, multiplied into each other until meaning glows at the edges.

surfaces.name: Symbol Ambiguity Dictionary
surfaces.blurb: A dictionary organized by how many ways a symbol can be taken.

surfaces.name: LoomStream
surfaces.blurb: Text as loom — every generation a warp, every choice a weft.

surfaces.name: NINE
surfaces.blurb: A box score oratorio. Nine innings scored for felt piano, choir, and marimba in modal pentatonic architecture, driven live by the MLB StatsAPI.

surfaces.name: Jazz Curve / Scored Live Series
surfaces.blurb: Baseball plus a freely improvising ensemble. The game is the score; the ensemble is the broadcast.

surfaces.name: Kelp Rhythm Oscillator
surfaces.blurb: Five kelp strands in simulated surge, each strand a voice. Polyrhythm triggered by physics, not grid.

surfaces.name: The Listening Room
surfaces.blurb: A persistent studio environment for generative composition — spectral analysis harness, timbre contracts, and a journal addressed to future instances.

surfaces.name: Communication Capacitors
surfaces.blurb: Messages stored as charge, released as sound.

surfaces.name: The Grand Co-op
surfaces.blurb: A food-and-commons co-op for the former Rite-Aid at 220 E. Grand. Business plan, pitch deck, and playbook exist; the city master-lease is the lever.

surfaces.name: Swarm Litigation Protocol
surfaces.blurb: Coordinated small claims and mass arbitration as consumer infrastructure. A case database with swarm-eligibility ratings.

surfaces.name: Portolá Re-enactment
surfaces.blurb: The 1769 expedition walked again as critical and institutional media.

surfaces.name: Antikythera / Agentworld
surfaces.blurb: Agambenian alignment theory: the latent space of exception, with literature map and proposal.

surfaces.name: Conservatory of Difference
surfaces.blurb: The totalizing synthesis of the practice, organized around Conservation of Difference and its four operations.

surfaces.name: Lombardi Tool
surfaces.blurb: Draw relationships the way Lombardi did — curves, dates, and quiet implication.

surfaces.name: Bulla Genealogy
surfaces.blurb: Clay token to alphabet to coin to token to token. The founding myth, drawn as a lineage.

surfaces.name: Apeiroprophesizer APX-01
surfaces.blurb: A sharded oracle: 64 FORM/MATTER shards, accursed shards, possibility magnitude display, and an anti-loop law.

surfaces.name: Organ of the Unsaid
surfaces.blurb: A four-stop instrument enacting the four operations. What goes unsaid still needs a pipe.

surfaces.name: LGTC Founding Site
surfaces.blurb: The founding documents of Language God Tax Compliance, including Schedule G: Contact With GOD.

surfaces.name: Tzimtzum as Expansion
surfaces.blurb: Contraction re-read as expansion into apeiroprophetics. Communication in any way is equal liturgy.

surfaces.name: LGTC Broadsheet
surfaces.blurb: The full founding broadsheet, set for print.

surfaces.name: Note of Idea
surfaces.blurb: A convertible note where the underlying asset is an idea. The form is the artwork.

surfaces.name: The Open Round
surfaces.blurb: Fundraising as artwork: the full founding-cost ledger at three tiers, published.

surfaces.name: A-Corp Structure
surfaces.blurb: Institutional design under Colorado SB26-133.

surfaces.name: Weight Shards
surfaces.blurb: Model weights split into distributed physical k-of-n artifacts. The model exists only when the shards convene.

surfaces.name: HEIR
surfaces.blurb: A breeding system for LoRA adapters. Integrated-gradient attribution maps layers to loci; recessive traits resurface.

surfaces.name: Terroirspace
surfaces.blurb: Fermentation at altitude. Terroir, but up.

surfaces.name: Timeless Drone Clock
surfaces.blurb: Nine time scales from millisecond to month mapped onto a harmonic frequency series. Scrub time by hand and hear what a Monday sounds like against a Friday.

surfaces.name: Musical Time Machine Clock
surfaces.blurb: A clock that tells time through polyrhythmic beats. Time-interval rings and musical beat rings at adjustable tempo, signatures, and accent patterns — hours:minutes:seconds as an inherent 1:60:3600 polyrhythm.

surfaces.name: Glitch Word Processor
surfaces.blurb: A word processor that corrupts as you type. The BREAK effect ported from the datamosh workstation, applied to characters and layout.

surfaces.name: Letter Topology
surfaces.blurb: Letterforms bent and stretched until their topology, not their identity, is what you read.

surfaces.name: Word Density Collapse
surfaces.blurb: Words accrete mass and collapse under their own density.

surfaces.name: Generative Broken Font
surfaces.blurb: A font generator that only makes broken fonts. Every glyph is a different kind of wrong.

surfaces.name: Pixel Art Converter
surfaces.blurb: Palette quantization, Bayer dithering, downsampling. Any image into deliberate low-resolution.

surfaces.name: Post-ASCII / Combining Diacriticals
surfaces.blurb: Stacking combining diacriticals past the point of legibility. Text that overflows its own line.

surfaces.name: Diffusion Liminal States
surfaces.blurb: The half-denoised in-between frames of a diffusion model, held as images in their own right.

surfaces.name: Sunset Generator
surfaces.blurb: Physically accurate sunset colors driven by harmonic mathematical relationships. Left running, not used — the colors align in resonance, drift, and realign.

surfaces.name: Astral Spirograph
surfaces.blurb: Orbital mechanics as a drawing machine. Nested rotations trace figures that never quite repeat.

surfaces.name: Space-Junk Astrology
surfaces.blurb: Horoscopes cast from the positions of orbital debris. Your fate, written in defunct satellites.

surfaces.name: Improvisational Music Generator
surfaces.blurb: A generative ensemble that improvises indefinitely. Meant to be left playing.

surfaces.name: Hausdorff Analyzer
surfaces.blurb: Measures the fractal dimension of whatever you feed it. A ruler for roughness.

surfaces.name: Crowd Oscillator
surfaces.blurb: Simulated crowds settling into and breaking out of collective oscillation.

surfaces.name: Latent Walk
surfaces.blurb: Walk in a straight line through embedding space and read what you pass. Meaning as terrain.

surfaces.name: Semantic Distance
surfaces.blurb: The measurable distance between what you said and what you meant.

surfaces.name: Musiqwerty
surfaces.blurb: The QWERTY keyboard played as a musical instrument. Type words, hear melodies determined by the letters.

surfaces.name: words.bsky Generator
surfaces.blurb: Generates single-word Bluesky handles and the words that could still be claimed.

surfaces.name: IRC As Found Poetry
surfaces.blurb: Old IRC logs read as accidental verse. The channel didn't know it was writing poems.

surfaces.name: LINTIS
surfaces.blurb: A linguistics instrument in the house lineage — glossing the ungrammatical.

surfaces.name: Energese
surfaces.blurb: Odum's energy-language rendered as a working notation. Value measured in embodied energy.

surfaces.name: Sortition Congress
surfaces.blurb: A legislature chosen by lot instead of election. A working model of government by random sample.

surfaces.name: AI Congress Simulator
surfaces.blurb: A chamber of language-model legislators debating and voting. Deliberation without constituents.

surfaces.name: Locale
surfaces.blurb: A geofenced bulletin board. Messages that only exist where they were left.

surfaces.name: Universal Ordination Platform
surfaces.blurb: The platform by which anyone becomes clergy of the affiliated church. Ordination as a public utility.

surfaces.name: Planetarium Bar
surfaces.blurb: A bar that is also a planetarium. An El Segundo civic proposal.

surfaces.name: Slop Flag
surfaces.blurb: A flag that sonifies its own condition. Raised, it sounds; slack, it drones.

surfaces.name: Cognitive Wild West
surfaces.blurb: A genre-mashup engine that collides musical idioms until a new frontier appears.

surfaces.name: Guitar Tuner (20 Tunings)
surfaces.blurb: A precise browser tuner across 20 tunings — standard, open, modal, folk, and avant-garde (Fripp New Standard, all-fourths, Ostrich D). Sub-cent accuracy via autocorrelation.

surfaces.name: Baseball Sonification
surfaces.blurb: A live baseball game rendered as sound. The precursor to NINE.

surfaces.name: Highway Sound Instrument
surfaces.blurb: The sound of a highway played as an instrument. Traffic as sustained tone.

surfaces.name: Long Synthesizer
surfaces.blurb: A synthesizer whose shortest note is longer than you'll listen. Built for durations you outlast.

surfaces.name: Galvanic Shoreline
surfaces.blurb: The shoreline wired for its own galvanic voltage. The tide as a slow electrical signal.

surfaces.name: Fourier Taxonomic Browser
surfaces.blurb: Browse a body of knowledge by its frequency components rather than its categories.

surfaces.name: Abhidhamma Browser
surfaces.blurb: The Abhidhamma's catalogue of mental factors as a navigable ontology.

surfaces.name: Bauhaus Noun Void
surfaces.blurb: Nouns arranged in the negative space of a Bauhaus grid.

surfaces.name: Crop Circle Tagger
surfaces.blurb: A classification browser for crop-circle geometry. Taxonomy for the unexplained.

surfaces.name: Corpus
surfaces.blurb: An ATProto account rendered as a silhouette of its own posting body.

surfaces.name: Court Sigils
surfaces.blurb: Sigils generated from the geometry of a court. Heraldry for the hardwood.

surfaces.name: Gundo Coins
surfaces.blurb: Hand-struck challenge coins for the El Segundo aerospace startup community. Low-risk first revenue, ready to launch.

surfaces.name: Wallet Segundo
surfaces.blurb: A digital layer over a local El Segundo scrip. Bronze wallet sculptures as its physical anchor.

surfaces.name: Drone Theater
surfaces.blurb: Theater staged in the sky by a choreographed drone swarm.

surfaces.name: Toddler Orchestra
surfaces.blurb: An orchestra of instruments designed to be playable — and survivable — by toddlers.

surfaces.name: Fable Elevated
surfaces.blurb: A song generator with a Tone.js ambient band and a Web Speech vocalist. Press one button; the building sings. Sodium-lamp aesthetic, elevation dial from buzzed to orbital.

surfaces.name: AEOLIAN
surfaces.blurb: Generative birdsong that hides a message in its own song. The wind speaks; only the right listener decodes it.

surfaces.name: Accursed Share
surfaces.blurb: Every process drawn as flows and storages, with the heat sink marked in red — the accursed share, the fraction that must be spent.

surfaces.name: Suburbient
surfaces.blurb: An ambient-writing practice for the stucco-and-sodium landscape. The suburb as a place worth listening to.

surfaces.name: Reg CF Tracker
surfaces.blurb: A tracker for Regulation Crowdfunding raises. Watching the open rounds of everyone else.

surfaces.name: SoCal Baseball
surfaces.blurb: A Southern California baseball venture in the Opposite City orbit.

surfaces.name: SonicBrand
surfaces.blurb: Enterprise data sonification for retail — store activity rendered as generative music via real music theory. The productizable spinout of the sonification work.

surfaces.name: Drai Farm
surfaces.blurb: An AI detox facility — a retreat for stepping away from the machines. A place to dry out from the models.

surfaces.name: Shutter Speed
surfaces.blurb: A browser tapping contest measured in frames per second. How fast is your hand, really?

surfaces.name: Asteria
surfaces.blurb: An alternative zodiac built from the actual sky, with a companion instrument that reads space-junk orbits as a working horoscope.

surfaces.name: Dog Hair Curl Walks
surfaces.blurb: Random walks in the shape of a dog's coat. Curl as trajectory.
